title: euchiton breviscapus
intro: Euchiton breviscapus, commonly known as New Zealand spinach or puha, is a flowering plant native to New Zealand and eastern Australia. It has been used for its nutritional and medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Euchiton breviscapus include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Euchiton breviscapus include flavonoids, carotenoids, and other phytochemicals that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
